easy: A deep color between blue and purple.

ex.en: She painted the night sky with indigo paint.
ex.ko: 그녀는 남색 물감으로 밤하늘을 칠했다.

easy: To put a cover over a dog's nose and mouth so it cannot bite.

ex.en: The vet had to muzzle the scared dog.
ex.ko: 수의사는 겁먹은 개에게 입마개를 씌워야 했다.

easy: To argue with someone because you do not agree.

ex.en: My brother and I quarrel about who gets the last cookie.
ex.ko: 형과 나는 마지막 쿠키를 누가 먹을지로 다툰다.

easy: To hit something very hard with your fist or a bat.

ex.en: The batter slugged the ball over the fence.
ex.ko: 타자가 공을 세게 쳐서 담장을 넘겼다.

easy: The soft sound a pigeon makes.

ex.en: We heard the coo of a pigeon outside the window.
ex.ko: 창밖에서 비둘기의 구구 소리가 들렸다.

easy: A small, silly fight with words about something not important.

ex.en: My sister and I had a spat about who sits by the window.
ex.ko: 누나와 나는 누가 창가에 앉을지로 말다툼을 했다.

easy: To make cloth stiff by putting a special powder from plants in the water.

ex.en: Dad starches his shirts so they stay flat.
ex.ko: 아빠는 셔츠가 빳빳하도록 풀을 먹이신다.

easy: To get smaller or weaker little by little.

ex.en: The rain tapered off before our game.
ex.ko: 우리 경기가 시작되기 전에 비가 점점 잦아들었다.

easy: When many people say that something is very good.

ex.en: The school play won loud acclaim from the crowd.
ex.ko: 학교 연극은 관객들에게 큰 갈채를 받았다.

easy: A big dog with thick fur that pulls sleds in snowy places.

ex.en: The husky ran through the snow pulling a sled.
ex.ko: 허스키는 눈 속에서 썰매를 끌며 달렸다.

easy: To sit on a high place like a branch.

ex.en: A little bird perched on the fence outside our school.
ex.ko: 작은 새 한 마리가 학교 밖 울타리에 앉았다.

easy: To move away from the middle in many directions.

ex.en: The smell of cookies diffused through the whole house.
ex.ko: 쿠키 냄새가 온 집안에 퍼졌다.

easy: A thin, shiny layer of sweet or salty sauce on top of food.

ex.en: The donut had a sweet sugar glaze on top.
ex.ko: 도넛 위에는 달콤한 설탕 글레이즈가 발려 있었다.

easy: A movie scene that is filmed one more time.

ex.en: The director asked for a retake because the dog ran away.
ex.ko: 개가 도망가서 감독은 재촬영을 요구했다.

easy: A tiny, sharp piece of wood or glass that breaks off.

ex.en: I got a splinter in my finger from the old fence.
ex.ko: 낡은 울타리 때문에 손가락에 가시가 박혔다.

easy: A long, unhappy complaint said in a high, crying voice.

ex.en: "Stop the whine and ask nicely," said Mom.
ex.ko: "징징대지 말고 예쁘게 말해 보렴." 엄마가 말씀하셨다.

easy: Someone who knows how to read and write.
ko: 글을 읽고 쓸 줄 아는 사람

ex.en: Learning to read makes you a literate person.
ex.ko: 읽기를 배우면 글을 읽고 쓸 줄 아는 사람이 된다.

easy: To catch on something sharp or rough and get stuck or torn.

ex.en: My sleeve snagged on a nail.
ex.ko: 내 소매가 못에 걸렸다.

easy: A quick squeeze of skin with two fingers.

ex.en: Grandma gave my cheek a gentle tweak.
ex.ko: 할머니가 내 볼을 살짝 꼬집으셨다.

easy: To make someone feel very sad or let down.

ex.en: The bad news dismayed the whole team.
ex.ko: 나쁜 소식에 팀 전체가 낙담했다.

easy: To make it hard for someone to move or get things done.

ex.en: The deep snow hampered our walk to school.
ex.ko: 깊은 눈이 우리의 등굣길을 방해했다.

easy: A group of baby birds or animals born and cared for together.

ex.en: The hen walked across the yard with her brood of chicks.
ex.ko: 암탉이 병아리 새끼들을 데리고 마당을 가로질렀다.

easy: Making things like scarves by looping yarn with a hooked needle.

ex.en: Grandma taught me crochet, and I made a small scarf.
ex.ko: 할머니가 코바늘뜨기를 가르쳐 주셔서 나는 작은 목도리를 만들었다.

easy: Wanting lots of money or things and never wanting to share.

ex.en: The grasping king wanted all the gold for himself.
ex.ko: 욕심 많은 왕은 금을 전부 혼자 갖고 싶어 했다.

easy: To dig or clean the soil with a tool that has a flat blade on a long stick.

ex.en: I hoed the garden with my dad.
ex.ko: 나는 아빠와 함께 텃밭을 괭이질했다.

easy: Getting thinner or smaller toward one end.

ex.en: We walked down a narrowing path in the woods.
ex.ko: 우리는 숲속의 점점 좁아지는 길을 걸었다.

easy: A soft, light color, like pale pink or light blue.

ex.en: She painted her room in pastel colors.
ex.ko: 그녀는 방을 파스텔 색으로 칠했다.

easy: A place where something has dropped down or bent in the middle.

ex.en: There is a sag in the middle of my old bed.
ex.ko: 내 낡은 침대는 가운데가 푹 꺼져 있다.

easy: To catch an animal with a trap.

ex.en: He tried to snare the rabbit with a rope trap.
ex.ko: 그는 밧줄 덫으로 토끼를 잡으려 했다.

easy: A color that is a mix of blue and green.

ex.en: My new backpack is teal.
ex.ko: 내 새 책가방은 청록색이다.

easy: A soft strip you put over a cut to keep it clean.

ex.en: Mom put a bandage on my scraped knee.
ex.ko: 엄마가 까진 내 무릎에 붕대를 붙여 주셨다.

easy: Hair twisted together in three parts to make a long rope.

ex.en: She wore her hair in a long braid for gym class.
ex.ko: 그녀는 체육 시간에 긴 땋은 머리를 하고 왔다.

easy: Toward the side where the sun comes up.

ex.en: The geese flew eastward over the lake.
ex.ko: 기러기들이 호수 위를 동쪽으로 날아갔다.

easy: A music word that means to play loudly.

ex.en: The band played the last part forte.
ex.ko: 밴드는 마지막 부분을 세게 연주했다.

easy: To fold the edge of cloth and sew it down.

ex.en: Mom hemmed my pants so they were not too long.
ex.ko: 엄마가 바지가 길지 않게 단을 꿰매 주셨다.

easy: In a sport like soccer, standing in a spot where the rules say you cannot be.

ex.en: The goal did not count because Sam was offside.
ex.ko: 샘이 오프사이드여서 그 골은 인정되지 않았다.

easy: To put one thing on top of another.

ex.en: She overlaid the cake with white frosting.
ex.ko: 그녀는 케이크 위에 하얀 크림을 덮어 발랐다.

easy: Counting something again, like votes, to make sure the number is right.

ex.en: The class asked for a recount of the votes for class president.
ex.ko: 반 친구들은 반장 선거의 재검표를 요청했다.

easy: To fill something again after it is empty.

ex.en: Can you refill my water bottle, please?
ex.ko: 내 물병 좀 다시 채워 줄래?

easy: A funny feeling on your skin when something touches it lightly.

ex.en: I felt a tickle on my foot from the grass.
ex.ko: 풀 때문에 발이 간질간질했다.

easy: The waste that comes out of an animal's body, like from a cow.

ex.en: The farmer used cow dung to help the plants grow.
ex.ko: 농부는 식물이 잘 자라도록 소똥을 썼다.

easy: A hole in a bike or car tire that lets the air out.

ex.en: My bike got a puncture, so we walked home.
ex.ko: 자전거가 펑크 나서 우리는 걸어서 집에 갔다.

easy: To put words at the bottom of a movie that show what people say.

ex.en: They subtitled the movie in Korean.
ex.ko: 그들은 그 영화에 한국어 자막을 넣었다.

easy: To paint with colors mixed with water.

ex.en: We watercolored flowers in art class.
ex.ko: 우리는 미술 시간에 수채물감으로 꽃을 그렸다.

easy: To dig in the sand at the beach to find clams.

ex.en: We clammed on the beach at low tide.
ex.ko: 우리는 썰물 때 해변에서 조개를 잡았다.
